2.value: The last torchbearers of a burned monastic order descend the vault the order died sealing. A seeded one-session co-op roguelike for 1-3 players: pick one of three omen-marked doors per floor, clear the room behind it, spend Embers at the campfire shrine, draft boons, and break the Vault Heart on the fourth floor. Permadeath -- one seed, one exact dungeon (~30 minutes). Type -help in game; -seed N before the first door replays any dungeon.
